Based on the latest documentation, shadcn/ui recently introduced a comprehensive `Chart` block built on top of Recharts. It uses a combination of CSS variables for theming and a central `<ChartContainer>` component to manage context.

To get started, you'll want to use the CLI: `npx shadcn-ui@latest add chart`.
How should I structure the React components for a multi-line chart comparing different spreadsheet metrics?

For a multi-line chart handling complex spreadsheet data, you should separate your data transformation logic from your presentation components. 

```tsx
import { Line, LineChart, XAxis, YAxis } from "recharts"
import { ChartContainer, ChartTooltip } from "@/components/ui/chart"

// Architecture details follow...
```
Keep your `<ChartConfig>` defined outside the render loop to prevent unnecessary re-renders when swapping dataset views.
